spans.s:
śíras, n. head. [cf. κάρα, ‘head’; Lat.
cerebrum, *ceres-ru-m, ‘brain’: w. the collateral
form śīrṣán, q. v., cf. Ger. Hirn,
Old High Ger. hirni, *hirsni, ‘brain’: akin
is also κρανίον, ‘skull.’]

śirīṣa, m. the tree Acacia Sirissa; as n.
the blossom.

śīrṣán, n. head. [śīrṣ-án is to śíras
(q. v.), as īrṣ-yā́ is to iras-yā́, see
these.]
